source.quote_free_summary: In a Ten-Dance competition each dance is a separate competition, and the Skating System is applied to all ten dances together to determine the winner.

requirement: Ten-Dance aggregate scoring (Skating System over all dances together) is NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future NDCA profile; DanceFlow produces one result per dance and no overall winner.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: a single-dance run carries no overall, combined or aggregate field

interpretation_notes: R-07(9). The ratification text cites p.22; re-reading the pinned PDF shows III.D.36 on printed p.23 (the book's own index lists Ten-Dance Competitions at 23; PDF page 30). The Skating System algorithm is NOT SPECIFIED IN PROVIDED SOURCE (OD-24).
